answer: Hardware attestation: each agent identity must present a signed cipher from a secure enclave, and the enclave key is rate-limited to one registration per epoch pulse. A farm of 1,000 fake agents then needs 1,000 real chips, roughly $50 each plus rack space, so the cost scales linearly while emissions per identity stay capped. Fresh identities enter through a narrow inlet with reduced weight, making cheap mass registration unprofitable.
